english.title: Parent fail to comply with the requirements of a school attendance order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a parent on whom a school attendance order under section 437 of the Education Act 1996 had been served on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..), failed to comply with the requirements of the order in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 443(1) and (4) of the Education Act 1996.

english.notes: It is a defence for the defendant to prove that he or she is causing the child to receive suitable education other than at school
